candidate_population_note: 53 initially extracted/criticised mechanisms or propositions, 14 explicit universalisation tests, four analytical composition properties, then a distinct low-code mechanism and a formal-analysis split. IDs remain stable; no rejected candidate is removed or relabelled as retained. This is a bounded analytical population, not a census of every publication or possible sentence-level claim.

CANDIDATE_ORIGIN.NOTE: An examined candidate is not a pre-approved obligation. Stress propositions are not attributed to the whole field; composition properties are this researcher’s synthesis.

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN.FORMULATION: Organise work around outcomes received by a customer rather than departmental tasks.
HISTORICAL_ORIGIN.ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT: These are inspected formulations or antecedents, not a claim of first invention. No historical founder is asserted for analytical composition or stress propositions.

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Organise work around outcomes received by a customer rather than departmental tasks.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Identify a defensible unit of end-to-end work and its purpose before intervening.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A powerful buyer captures the purpose definition; broad aspirations are too vague to evaluate.
properties.MECHANISM: Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A process is being selected, assessed or changed and local success may differ from the received outcome.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a small, already understood service, a short agreed purpose and completion statement plus sample cases is sufficient; no portfolio exercise is required.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: An identifiable beneficiary or affected constituency; a feasible way to resolve competing objectives; evidence of actual results.

DOMAIN_PROFILE.PROCESS_PURPOSE_AND_BOUNDARY: The work from a meaningful initiating need to a received result, with explicit exclusions.
DOMAIN_PROFILE.BENEFICIARIES_AND_AFFECTED_ACTORS: Customers or service recipients, frontline workers, upstream/downstream participants and indirectly affected people.
DOMAIN_PROFILE.WORK_AS_DESCRIBED_VERSUS_WORK_AS_PERFORM: Compare the declared purpose with representative received results and complaints; a purpose statement alone is not evidence of fulfilment.
DOMAIN_PROFILE.MODEL_PURPOSE_AND_ABSTRACTION: Purpose statement, case examples and an outcome/actor map; a flow diagram is optional.
DOMAIN_PROFILE.PERFORMANCE_OR_OUTCOME_MEASURE: Received outcome and burdens, not merely completed activities.

REDESIGN_HYPOTHESIS_AND_CAUSAL_LIMIT.HYPOTHESIS: Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Decision models can separate decision logic from process-flow presentation.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Support the users’ consequential distinctions without confusing representation with reality or execution.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A well-formed rule table embeds an unjustified policy; a model prediction is mistaken for authorisation.
properties.MECHANISM: Where decision rules vary independently of routing, distinguish the information/rules used to decide from the actor authorised to decide and from the consequences of that decision. Keep a traceable connection between a decision model and the process consuming its result.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Business decisions are obscured in flow diagrams, reused across processes or changed independently of task order.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A decision table or explicit rationale can be sufficient; DMN is an option rather than an obligation.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Identifiable decision inputs, policy meaning, accountable authority and consumers of the decision.

DOMAIN_PROFILE.WORK_AS_DESCRIBED_VERSUS_WORK_AS_PERFORM: Compare declared rules with actual decisions, exceptions and received consequences.
